preservedResponsibilities: Original resolve_func converts nullable public/system IDs through actual RTL values, calls the genuine XEntityResolver and transfers actual InputSource stream ownership to a heap context and native libxml2 input buffer. XML_CHAR_ENCODING_NONE remains the original argument for both native calls; returned encoding/identifier metadata is not substituted (CALC-532/WRITER466). Native source context close/freeOnClose ordering and its recorded failure behavior remain unchanged. Actual public and system-only external DTDs exercise the resolver ABI with explicit raw-library DTDLOAD qualification; builder default options remain zero. Builder/UCB orchestration, full source service QA, physical ABI and DOCX/XLSX/UI acceptance remain unverified.
omittedResponsibilities: Actual builder lookup/acquisition and UCB default resolver/URI service orchestration remain unported.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original documentbuilder.cxx resolve_func is separated as a cohesive native input responsibility to respect the authored module size budget. Builder acquisition remains at its future actual call site, not a substitute provider.
